capabilities: Add a Copy Embed Code option to the right-click menu on images
Copy wikilink embed syntax for local images
Copy markdown embed syntax for external images
Detect images inside nested embeds via DOM traversal
Work in Live Preview and Reading Mode
extras: Manual installation only (no community plugin store instructions); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's editor-menu API depends on cursor position, which doesn't move when right-clicking an image, especially inside nested embeds, so copying an image's embed code is unreliable.
summary: Context-menu plugin that adds a 'Copy Embed Code' option for images, copying wikilink or markdown embed syntax to the clipboard.
